heading: Abusive swaps
lead: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission or the Securities and Exchange Commission, or both, individually may, by rule or order—

tree.text: collect information as may be necessary concerning the markets for any types of—

children.text: swap (as defined in section 1a of title 7); or
security-based swap (as defined in section 1a of title 7); and

tree.text: issue a report with respect to any types of swaps or security-based swaps that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission or the Securities and Exchange Commission determines to be detrimental to—

children.text: the stability of a financial market; or
